title: Unit 30 Consolidation: Hungarian Foreign Policy and Energy Policy, 2010–2026
goal: I can sum up the disputes about foreign policy between 2010 and 2026, with the source of each view.
I can report the views about the Opening to the East, Paks II, the vetoes and the Chinese investments, with the source of each.
I can close an account of foreign policy with the dated facts of the spring of 2026.
